$$

feedback.problem:
Find the standard matrix that represents  the  linear  transformation $T$, where

$$
T:[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]⟶[\begin{aligned}5y-12x \\ x+3y\end{aligned}].
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
First, rewrite the order of the variables in the usual way:

$$
T:[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]⟶[\begin{aligned}-12x+5y \\ x+3y\end{aligned}]
$$

We require a $2\times 2$ matrix $T$ such that
    

$$
T\cdot [\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}-12x+5y \\ x+3y\end{aligned}].
$$

Notice that
    

$$
[\begin{aligned}-12 & 5 \\ 1 & 3\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}-12x+5y \\ x+3y\end{aligned}].
$$

    Therefore, the matrix which represents the linear transformation $T$ is
    

$$
[\begin{aligned}-12 & 5 \\ 1 & 3\end{aligned}].
$$
